title: 10 Best AI Tools for Indie Hackers in 2026 (Tested and Ranked)
summary: The top AI tools indie hackers actually use to build, ship, and grow solo products in 2026. Ranked by how much they replace a team — not by marketing claims.
body_markdown: They serve different use cases. Blink is for building full-stack products from scratch — you describe what you want and get a deployed, working app with database and auth included. Cursor is for developers who already have a codebase and want AI to help them write, debug, and refactor code faster. Many indie hackers use both: Blink for the initial product scaffold and for non-technical features, Cursor for complex business logic they want precise control over. If you're starting fresh with no existing code, Blink is the faster path to a shipped product.
